payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses DP to compute Fibonacci-like numbers for row and column independent counts, then combines combinatorially (2*(F(n+2)+F(m+2)-1)) modulo 1e9+7.
payload.rationale: The solution reduces grid constraints to 1D independent row/column counts with a 1D DP recurrence count_1[i]=count_1[i-1]+count_2[i-1], count_2[i]=count_1[i-1] (Fibonacci), and combines results using combinatorial formula.
